preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 512 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= R <= 8 and 1 <= C <= 8 and 1 <= K <= 8 for R, C, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, R, C, and K must be integers between 1 and 8 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly one line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i].isdigit() for i, stdout_lines in enumerate([stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: Each output line must be a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout_lines[i]) <= 64 for i, stdout_lines in enumerate([stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be between 1 and 64 inclusive (the maximum possible reachable squares on an 8x8 board).

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == count_reachable_squares(R, C, K) for i, (R, C, K) in enumerate(test_cases) for stdout_lines in [stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output must equal the number of squares reachable by the king in at most K moves, where count_reachable_squares(R, C, K) is defined as the number of unique squares (r, c) such that there exists a sequence of at most K king moves from (R, C) to (r, c).
